title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 20): To coach a Predator
summary: Part 20 of NH's attack series on fitness YouTuber Jason Blaha. After Blaha reportedly claimed NH's briefly deleted channel was removed for illegal content, NH presents old forum posts, deleted videos and second-hand accounts he says show predatory attitudes; these are NH's own unverified allegations, which he admits do not amount to a legal case.
claims: NH says he made the series to expose Blaha and considers Blaha's channel and coaching business finished as a result
NH's channel was briefly taken down and reinstated after YouTube reviewed his roughly 20 Blaha videos with no strike, which he reads as proof Blaha is irrelevant to YouTube
NH says Blaha falsely claimed credit for the deletion and then accused NH of posting illegal content, which triggered this episode
NH accuses Blaha, based on old forum posts and deleted videos, of predatory attitudes toward minors; he states these are allegations, not a built legal case
NH argues Blaha always projects: what he accuses others of reveals what he fears being called
NH claims Blaha invented family abuse stories to deflect blame and gain sympathy, citing them only surfacing after accusations
NH says over a dozen people he contacted told him the same second-hand story about Blaha's family leaving suddenly; unverified
NH vows to keep the series going because he now considers Blaha dangerous rather than just a liar
